subject: Tenant segmentation: witness purge & deletion verification plan

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence for tenant segmentation + deletion verification for Dedicated cluster

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our risk assessment we need a clear, demonstrable package showing how tenant segmentation and deletion work on a Dedicated deployment that is region-pinned to us-west-2. Specifically FinTrust needs:

- A short runbook that describes steps to pin a tenant to a region and confirm no cross-region replication for that tenant.
- Evidence artifacts showing a sample tenant deletion: scrub logs, snapshot deletion confirmations, and any snapshot hashes/manifests.
- Timing for how long a complete erase cycle takes (from request to final wipe of any retained backups).
- An auditable statement we can include with our compliance package that a purge occurred (signed by Redwood ops/engineering).

Target: deliver the artifacts and a proposed witness purge by end of month (Apr 30). Can you outline what you can provide and the cadence for a short live demo/witness?

Best,
Elena
Elena Mirov
Head of Cloud Security
FinTrust

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three artifact categories and run a witnessed purge. High-level proposal:

1) Artifacts we will provide (ZIP with links):
   - Segmentation runbook (how region pinning is configured and enforced at provisioning time).
   - Wipe/playbook with step-by-step ops commands we execute for a tenant-erase.
   - Sample scrub logs and snapshot manifests for a red-team tenant (redacted UIDs).
   - Signed attestation template (ops/eng sign-off).

2) Witness purge plan:
   - Schedule a 45-minute session with your security + one ops witness. We will perform a purge on a dedicated test tenant pinned to us-west-2 and share live logs, then upload the post-wipe manifests.
   - We will also capture SHA256 hashes of snapshots before deletion and manifest lines after deletion to show removal from retention tables.

3) Timing: we can collect artifacts within 5 business days; the witness purge can be scheduled any time during the week of Apr 27–30. Full post-wipe verification materials will be delivered within 48 hours after the purge.

Looping in Ben (ops) and Laura (SRE) to confirm feasibility and the exact artifact set. Aditya — please flag any contractual constraints.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Security Liaison

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for tenant segmentation + deletion verification for Dedicated cluster

Sofia / team —

We can support the requested artifacts. A few technical notes (so FinTrust knows what the evidence will look like):

- Region pinning: Dedicated tenants are provisioned to resource pools tied to a physical AZ/region. We do not enable cross-region replication for pinned tenants; snapshot replications are disabled unless specifically requested and contracted. The runbook will show the config flags (region_hint, replication_profile=none).

- Snapshot lifecycle: for some customers we retain daily snapshots for N days; when a delete request is issued we perform the following sequence:
  1) Mark tenant as "pending deletion" in the control plane (prevents new writes).
  2) Flush and remove ephemeral caches (LRU and KV layers).
  3) Delete active VM/containers and zero metadata pointers.
  4) Queue snapshot deletions and purge retention records.
  5) Garbage collect storage blocks over the configured retention window and emit scrub events.

- Evidence types:
  * scrub log samples (CSV rows showing timestamps, object ids, ops user id).
  * snapshot manifest before-delete (JSON manifest with object references + SHA256).
  * post-delete manifest and control-plane deletion events (log entries).
  * control plane audit entries showing the delete request id and operator.

- Duration: end-to-end for a standard tenant (no legal hold) is typically 24–72 hours for the control-plane sweep and metadata removal, with underlying block-level GC completing on the configured storage TTL (we'll provide concrete numbers for the FinTrust environment).

I'll prepare a small sample artifact set and a sanitized scrub log. Attaching the runbook and wipe playbook drafts for review.

Attachments: segmentation-runbook.pdf, wipe-playbook.txt, ops-scrub-log-sample.csv

Ben Carter
Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: evidence for tenant segmentation + deletion verification for Dedicated cluster

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from FinTrust security: 

- For the witness purge we need the live session to include:
  * Terminal view of the deletion command and immediate control-plane audit entries (to tie the command to the audit id).
  * Live display of the manifest/hash removal from our tenant's retention table.
  * A short signed statement (ops/engineering) that the demonstration represents production-equivalent steps.

- Also please include what guarantees exist if Legal Hold or eDiscovery requests are later opened. We realize that can extend retention windows; we want that spelled out in the attestation.

We are happy to take sanitized artifacts. Will schedule the witness session for Apr 29 at 10:00 PT if that works.

Elena

Elena —

Thanks — Apr 29 worked well. Summary and deliverables we uploaded to the shared drive (links below):

- Evidence uploaded: segmentation-runbook.pdf, wipe-playbook.txt, ops-scrub-log-sample.csv (sanitized), signed-attestation.pdf (ops + eng).
- Witness session: Apr 29 10:00 PT — operations team performed a test purge on a dedicated test tenant pinned to us-west-2. Live control-plane audit id: REDW-DEL-20260429-8893.
- Artifacts delivered within 24 hours post-demo; post-wipe manifests and the control-plane deletion entries are in the Drive folder.

Notes on Legal Hold: if FinTrust requires Legal Hold we will place the tenant in a hold state and cannot complete the purge; our attestation will reflect the presence or absence of holds. If a hold is later lifted we can perform the same purge sequence and provide a new attestation and scrub logs. Timing for block-level GC is subject to storage provider TTLs; we include specific TTL values for the FinTrust tenancy in the runbook.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A7FinTrustEvidence
Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4217

If you need any additional artifacts (forensic-ready disk manifests, chain-of-custody signatures), reply and we will scope those.

Thanks everyone —
